analyst_view.overall: Early view: this is a bottom-of-the-table game, with Willem II last on 3 points and without a league win, and ADO Den Haag 17th on 9. Neither club is in Europe, so both should have a full week to prepare. One match report says Willem II lost 7-0 at PSV recently, and I found no current news on manager changes or injuries for either club, so this view rests on form and the stakes.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean a little lower: both sides are under heavy pressure near the bottom and games like this often get tight and nervous. Willem II's poor defence (goal difference of minus 29) is the main reason the lean is only slight.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners. Willem II at home should push forward and earn corners, which fits the site's home-heavy split, so I see no reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. I lean higher because this is a relegation six-pointer between the bottom two, where tackles get heavier and frustration builds, especially for a home side still looking for a first win. The referee is not known yet.
